name: The Summer We Disappeared
source:
Julius has decided that nothing is worth being around for daily life anymore. Surely nothing could change that... Not even his neighbor, Margaret, coming over to talk to him for the first time. After talking to her, he decides that one more day is worth showing her his favorite spot at the park so that she can enjoy it while he's gone. What's one more day, or one more after that, or... Maybe life really can have something good in it. 

Learn what's keeping these two teenagers from connecting with anyone else and how it helps them to connect with each other instead. Set in the 90s where nostalgia is just as prevalent as reality.  

[From [url=https://minilycan.itch.io/the-summer-we-disappeared]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朱利叶斯早已心灰意冷，觉得这日复一日的生活再也没有任何值得留恋的东西了。想必没有任何事能动摇他的念头……哪怕是从未搭过话的邻居少女玛格丽特第一次主动登门找他聊天也不例外。然而与她交谈过后，他决定不妨多活一天——带她去看看公园里自己最喜欢的秘密角落，好让她在自己离开人世后也能去那里享受时光。多活一天又何妨，再多活一天、再下一天呢……或许这人生里，真的还藏着一些美好的事物。

探索究竟是什么阻碍了这两名少男少女与外人敞开心扉，又是什么反而促成了他们彼此心灵相通。故事背景设定在怀旧气息与现实生活同样鲜明的20世纪90年代。

[摘自[url=https://minilycan.itch.io/the-summer-we-disappeared]itch.io[/url]]
